name: io.github.knight60/arcgis-pro-mcp
title: ArcGIS Pro MCP
description: Drive a live ArcGIS Pro session in plain language. An ArcGIS Pro add-in that speaks MCP from inside Pro's own process: 112 tools across layers, attributes, selections, symbology, layouts and rasters, plus every one of Pro's ~2,000 geoprocessing tools by name and arbitrary arcpy.
